recipe.visualDefinition: A square-format portrait of a bearded man in western attire, set within a wide, textured terracotta-colored border featuring delicate Victorian-style corner flourishes. The central image uses soft, natural outdoor lighting with a shallow depth of field, emphasizing a warm, grainy 1970s film quality.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's warm skin tones harmonize with the terracotta border.
The sharp, dark typography in the upper right balances the visual weight of the subject on the left.
The ornate border creates a 'window' effect, separating the modern portrait from a classical frame.
The blue sky in the background provides a cool contrast to the dominant warm earth tones.
coreInvariants: Square composition with a thick, solid-color outer frame.
Subject wearing denim and leather textures.
Combination of a heavy serif display font and a light, fluid script.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait, slightly off-center to the left, occupying approximately 60% of the inner frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile, framed by long hair and a beard.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves right to the bold display text, then down to the secondary script text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant of the inner image is reserved for typographic elements against a clear sky.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Denim Blue and Sky Blue (Subject's shirt and background)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Black (Typography and leather vest shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted saturation with a mid-range value, typical of aged color film prints.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast flared serif and monolinear script
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses heavy vertical strokes with sharp, triangular serifs.
Script text is slanted, continuous, and mimics fountain pen handwriting.
Display characters feature slight irregularities to suggest hand-tooling.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Enlarged initial capitals in the display name.
Extended descenders and ascenders in the script to create a sense of motion.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast weight pairing: heavy architectural serif with delicate organic script.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the flared, high-contrast serif look of the 70s.
Provides the necessary informal, handwritten contrast.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s-style film photograph of a man with long hair and a beard, wearing a denim shirt and leather vest, smiling outdoors at sunset. Place this image inside a wide terracotta-colored square frame with ornate black Victorian corner filigree.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned text in the upper right sky area. Use a bold, flared serif font for the top two lines and a light, slanted script font for the bottom two lines. Ensure the text is solid black with a very subtle distress texture.

verificationChecks: Is the border color a warm terracotta?
Are there ornate flourishes in the corners?
Does the image have a grainy, analog film texture?

mustRedesign: Specific artist names or album titles
postGenerationChecks: Verify the script text doesn't overlap the subject's face.
Check that the corner ornaments are symmetrical.
Ensure the color of the sky is a muted, natural blue.
Confirm the overall square aspect ratio is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a [Subject Type] portrait in [Lighting Condition], frame it with a [Color] [Texture] border featuring [Ornament Style] corners, and apply [Typography Pairing] in the [Position] quadrant.
